description:
Modified internal rate of return: single-valued, unlike irr.

The preferred figure for non-conventional cashflows (more than one sign change),
since it has exactly one solution given the finance and reinvestment rates.

cashflows.description: Cashflows by period; needs >=1 negative and >=1 positive.

finance_rate.description: Per-period rate to finance (discount) negative cashflows, as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 for 8%.

reinvest_rate.description: Per-period rate to reinvest (compound) positive cashflows, as a decimal, e.g. 0.06 for 6%.

name: mirr

outputSchema.description: Modified internal rate of return (always unique given the two rates).

finance_rate.description: Per-period rate used to discount negative cashflows, as a decimal.

mirr.description: Modified IRR per period, as a decimal (annualize externally if needed).

reinvest_rate.description: Per-period rate used to compound positive cashflows, as a decimal.

title: Modified Internal Rate of Return
